instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide shot, eye-level angle, in an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and an office printer in the background. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, extending his right arm to touch the chest of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the left with her back partially to the camera, facing right towards him. The scene is lit by overhead lighting.
